A1.justification: Both complete, readable 41-page PDFs describe the same OTP-FM work. Text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–I support reliable comparison; the appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic experiments, single-cell trajectory evaluations, oceanographic and air-quality experiments, and ablations in Section 6 and Appendices F–I.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and OTP-FM results, including the benchmark and ablation results in Tables 2–7.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1's written training update is corrected from a MeanFlow target using conditional velocity in the derivative term to the iMF computation defined by Eq. 7. This is a localized algorithm-specification correction: Eqs. 7 and 19 and Appendix C.2 already specified iMF in v1, so it does not establish a changed experimental implementation.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic Gaussian scenarios, EB and CITE single-cell datasets, Gulf of Mexico transport data, and Beijing PM2.5 data. No evaluated domain or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same baseline methods and populated comparison cells. Tables 4, 6 and 7 retain MMFM and 3MSBM, while Table 5 retains the same consistency-model and loss comparisons.

E3.justification: The splits, dimensional representations, preprocessing, metrics, training budgets and inference settings in Section 6 and Appendices F–I are unchanged. The pseudocode correction does not report a revised experimental protocol or rerun.

E4.justification: Potential, strength, temporal-kernel, curriculum, consistency-model and loss ablations remain unchanged in Tables 2 and 5. The supplementary few-step inference, kernel-failure and trajectory analyses are also retained without changes.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains five-seed mean and standard-deviation reporting where available; Table 5 retains its single-seed qualification for nonbaseline ablations. Tables 6–7 retain the same five-seed summaries. No uncertainty-reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results, rankings and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 4 retains OTP-FM (W2^2) holdout W2 scores of 0.107 ± 0.001 on Gulf of Mexico and 17.28 ± 0.56 on Beijing.

T1.justification: The hard-potential limit, Euler–Lagrange equations, alignment bounds and their proofs remain unchanged, as do the derivations in Appendices B–E. The corrected algorithm invokes the existing iMF definition rather than introducing new mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about soft-potential multimarginal flow matching, theoretical guarantees, simulation-free training, performance and efficiency. The added article in 'a theoretical bound' is grammatical.

C2.justification: Interpretations of flexible interpolation, potential choices and kernel instability are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning physical plausibility, fixed couplings, density estimation and tuning burden.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 now directs implementation to the correct iMF/JVP expression and its loss against conditional velocity, resolving contradictory reproduction instructions. Architecture, hyperparameter, hardware and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5, the cited works and bibliography are unchanged. Both MeanFlow and improved MeanFlow were already cited and distinguished in v1; the pseudocode correction introduces no new research positioning.

P1.justification: Small grammatical corrections add missing articles in the contribution and parametrization descriptions, and Algorithm 1's wording is revised. The version/date marking changes, but section organization and the broader narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Algorithm 1 contracts from 14 to 13 lines, accompanied by small spacing and text-reflow changes on the affected pages. Figures and tables retain their content and presentation; no displays are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v1's Algorithm 1 gave a MeanFlow update despite Eqs. 7 and 19 and Appendix C.2 specifying iMF. v2 aligns the pseudocode with that existing objective, reducing the risk of implementing the wrong update. This is a useful, limited improvement in consistency and reproducibility; the scientific evidence and theoretical content remain unchanged.
